exposure: Duration of the second stage of labor: ≤3 hours, 3-4 hours, 4-5 hours, 5-6 hours, and >6 hours
Duration of the second stage of labor
duration of the second stage of labor
cohort: 6273 women with term, singleton pregnancies in cephalic presentation who underwent cesarean delivery during the second stage of labor
finding: While a longer second stage of labor was linked to certain factors like a longer maternal hospital stay, a higher birth weight, and fewer instances of general anesthesia, there was no statistically significant rise in either maternal or neonatal morbidity rates as the second stage of labor became longer.
